prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent PNG monster miniature for a tactical tabletop game, readable at 64 pixels.
Primary request: create ONE GIANT EEL token, a clearly fish-like eel rather than another coiled snake.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved brown snake token STYLE reference only: high overhead oblique camera, matte hand-painted sculptural forms, neutral gray-brown shallow round base, soft upper-left light. Do NOT copy its snake scale pattern, head, tongue or circular coil pose. Image 2 is the original GIANT EEL sprite SPECIES IDENTITY reference: dark blue-gray eel, smooth elongated aquatic body, paler lower side, narrow lengthwise fin edges. The game describes a snake-like aquatic creature; this is the ordinary giant eel, not an electric eel.
Subject: a thick smooth slate-blue eel with a fish-shaped blunt tapered head, small eyes, slightly open broad fish mouth and a subtle gill slit. Long body forms a flowing broad S-curve across the disc, with a large head at the lower-left and tapered tail curving back toward the upper-right. A continuous visibly lighter gray-blue dorsal/caudal fin runs along its back and around the tapering tail; a small pectoral fin near the head reinforces fish identity. Make fin edges broad enough to read at 64px. No forked snake tongue, no snake hood, no reptile scales, no external ears, legs, antlers or spikes. No electricity.
Style: hand-painted carved resin/wood fantasy miniature, matte simplified chunky shapes, selective drybrush highlights along the body and fin edge. The body has a broad cool blue-gray highlight so it does not merge into the dark base. No wet photorealistic shine.
Composition: one complete sculptural eel centered on one neutral shallow nearly circular dark gray-brown base. High overhead oblique view. Eel fills 75–88% of the disc but EVERY fin and tail tip stays safely INSIDE the base outline, continuous neutral rim visible all around. Disc about 86% of square canvas width, centered, not a tall pedestal, not a narrow ellipse.
Lighting: soft upper-left light, short contact shadow confined to disc interior.
Background: genuine transparent PNG alpha outside the disc, clean corners. Creature sits directly on neutral base; NO water surface, waves, splashes, bubbles, reeds, stones or aquarium scene.
Avoid: faction ring, colored rim, status glow, letters, numbers, rank symbols, label, watermark, supports, ground plane or any cast shadow outside the disc.

references.role: style only: camera, neutral thin base, matte painted miniature material and lighting
original species identity; inspected with view_image

source_identity_evidence: data/general/npcs/aquatic_critter.lua:45-46: giant eel, snake-like aquatic creature; original sprite shows dark blue-gray sinuous body.
processing: Copied original generated PNG byte-for-byte. No cleanup, masking, repaint, recolor or resizing performed by this agent.

review.visual: Strong broad S-shaped cool body, continuous pale fin edge, fish head and pectoral fin distinguish it from both snakes. No water plane, splashes, electricity, hood or forked tongue.
review.transparency: Real RGBA alpha with zero-alpha corners. Very faint native alpha 1–7 dust occurs beyond the visible disc; recorded and preserved. Alpha>=8 bbox is for sizing inspection only.
review.status: Recommended for parent uniform export and 48/64/96px inspection; not a gameplay-validated asset.
